author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete these GO terms:
- GO:0097734 extracellular exosome biogenesis
- GO:0071971 extracellular exosome assembly
- GO:0140112 extracellular vesicle biogenesis
- GO:0140113 extracellular microvesicle biogenesis
- GO:1903551 regulation of extracellular exosome assembly
- GO:1903552 negative regulation of extracellular exosome assembly
- GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32713

Impacted groups (experimental annotations):
UniProt	12
ParkinsonsUK-UCL	1 - done

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)
* None. There are no InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keyword, UniRule or EC mappings to these terms.

### Annotations needing action (6 annotations, all UniProt)

| Gene | Current term | Ref | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| CD34 (human, P28906) | GO:0071971 extracellular exosome assembly (IDA) | PMID:21835908 | **Remove.** The paper shows that CD34+ cells secrete exosomes; CD34 is the cell-sorting marker and the CD34 protein is not tested. |
| Pdcd6ip (mouse, MGI:1333753) | GO:0097734 extracellular exosome biogenesis (IMP) | PMID:25686249 | **Replace with GO:1990182 exosomal secretion.** "As a control, we confirmed that Alix knockdown impaired exosome production in wild-type MEFs." |
| ARRDC1 (human, Q8N5I2) | GO:0140112 extracellular vesicle biogenesis (IMP) | PMID:27462458 | **Replace with GO:0006900 vesicle budding from membrane.** Arrdc1 and Arrdc4 knockout MEFs show that they "are non-redundant positive regulators of EV release". These are plasma-membrane-derived vesicles, not MVB-derived exosomes. |
| Arrdc4 (mouse, MGI:1913662) | GO:0140112 extracellular vesicle biogenesis (IMP) | PMID:27462458 | **Replace with GO:0006900 vesicle budding from membrane**, as for ARRDC1. |
| PDCD6IP (human, Q8WUM4) | GO:1903551 regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:24105262 | **Remove.** The increased signal after ALIX knockdown is more MHC II cargo per exosome, not more exosomes: "These results suggest a change in exosome composition due to ALIX depletion, rather than a change in exosome yield." ALIX knockdown raised MHC II mRNA, and in dendritic cells it "does not increase MHC II secretion on DC exosomes". |
| EXO70E2 (Arabidopsis, AT5G61010) | GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IDA) | PMID:24307681 | **Remove.** EXPO is "a double-membrane organelle mediating unconventional protein secretion in plants"; it is not an MVB and does not produce exosomes. |

### Annotations already covered (no action needed; 7 annotations)

These genes are already annotated from the same paper to GO:1903543 positive regulation of exosomal secretion, so the annotations to the obsolete terms can simply be dropped.

| Gene | Current term | Ref | Group |
|---|---|---|---|
| ATP13A2 (human, Q9NQ11) | GO:0097734 extracellular exosome biogenesis (IMP) | PMID:25392495 | ParkinsonsUK-UCL |
| STAM (human, Q92783) | GO:1903551 regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:24105262 | UniProt |
| TSG101 (human, Q99816) | GO:1903551 regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:24105262 | UniProt |
| SDCBP (human, O00560) | GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:22660413 | UniProt |
| SDC1 (human, P18827) | GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:22660413 | UniProt |
| SDC4 (human, P31431) | GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:22660413 | UniProt |
| PDCD6IP (human, Q8WUM4) | GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly (IMP) | PMID:22660413 | UniProt |

Note for PAINT: GO:1903553 positive regulation of extracellular exosome assembly has 29 IBA annotations. The obsolete term will carry `consider: GO:1903543` (positive regulation of exosomal secretion), not `replaced_by`, so these will not move automatically.

Full text was read for the five papers behind the annotations needing action.

Thanks.
